WITH per AS (
  SELECT min(calendar_date) AS d0, max(calendar_date) AS d1, count(*) AS days, min(fiscal_week) AS w0, max(fiscal_week) AS w1
  FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=3
),
lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.channel_code, f.etl_loaded_at, p.sku, p.subcategory AS sub_then, cp.subcategory AS sub_now, p.category, s.store_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
  , per
  WHERE s.store_id=108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN per.d0 AND per.d1
)
SELECT (SELECT d0 FROM per) AS d0, (SELECT d1 FROM per) AS d1, (SELECT days FROM per) AS days, (SELECT w0||'-'||w1 FROM per) AS weeks,
  count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_rl,
  sum(quantity) FILTER (WHERE sub_now='Interior Paint' AND category<>'ZZ Test') AS units_now,
  sum(quantity) FILTER (WHERE sub_then='Interior Paint') AS units_then,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE sub_now='Interior Paint') AS n_ip_lines,
  count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FILTER (WHERE sub_now='Interior Paint') AS n_ip_ids,
  sum(quantity) FILTER (WHERE sub_now='Interior Paint' AND staff_purchase_flag) AS staff_units,
  sum(quantity) FILTER (WHERE sub_now='Interior Paint' AND quantity<=0) AS nonpos,
  count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS n_loads
FROM lines

WITH per AS (
  SELECT min(calendar_date) AS d0, max(calendar_date) AS d1 FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=3
),
mine AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date, f.quantity, f.net_amount, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key, per
  WHERE s.store_id=108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN per.d0 AND per.d1
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT sum(units_sold) AS units, sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS gross_net, sum(returns_net) AS ret, sum(net_sales) AS ns, count(*) AS n_days, min(business_date) AS mn, max(business_date) AS mx
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales, per WHERE store_id=108 AND business_date BETWEEN per.d0 AND per.d1
)
SELECT (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM mine) AS fact_units, (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM mine WHERE category<>'ZZ Test') AS fact_units_noZZ,
  (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM mine) AS fact_net, (SELECT count(*) FROM mine WHERE category='ZZ Test') AS zz_lines,
  c.units, c.gross_net, c.ret, c.ns, c.n_days, c.mn, c.mx,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT sale_date) FROM mine) AS fact_days
FROM ctl c

WITH per AS (
  SELECT min(calendar_date) AS d0, max(calendar_date) AS d1 FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=3
)
SELECT 'returns_booked_in_period' AS k, CAST(sum(r.quantity_returned) AS VARCHAR) AS v, CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR) AS n
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current, per
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND r.return_date BETWEEN per.d0 AND per.d1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_of_period_sales', CAST(sum(r.quantity_returned) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR)
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current, per
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN per.d0 AND per.d1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'name_looks_interior_paint_other_sub', p.subcategory||' | '||p.category, CAST(count(DISTINCT p.sku) AS VARCHAR)
FROM dim_product p WHERE p.is_current AND p.subcategory<>'Interior Paint' AND (p.product_name ILIKE '%interior%' OR p.product_name ILIKE '%emulsion%' OR p.product_name ILIKE '%wall paint%' OR p.product_name ILIKE '%sisämaali%')
GROUP BY p.subcategory, p.category
UNION ALL
SELECT 'multi_version_skus', p.sku||' '||p.subcategory||' '||p.category||' '||p.valid_from||'..'||p.valid_to, CAST(p.is_current AS VARCHAR)
FROM dim_product p WHERE p.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM dim_product GROUP BY sku HAVING count(*)>1 AND bool_or(subcategory='Interior Paint'))

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, 'Interior Paint' AS subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108
  AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
